messages.subject: New instruction — Rashid grievance
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

We've received a formal grievance from Imran Rashid, our outgoing CCO. It alleges unfair treatment, age discrimination and a protected disclosure. The new CEO wants this handled carefully and quickly. Can Whitfield Carter take this on? Happy to have a call tomorrow.

Best,
Patricia Vaughan
General Counsel & Company Secretary
Calverton Industries Limited

messages.subject: RE: New instruction — Rashid grievance
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Patricia,

Thank you — yes, we'd be glad to act. Tom Gallagher will lead day to day with support from Elena Marchetti. I attach our engagement letter setting out scope and terms; please sign and return the copy. In the meantime please make sure all relevant documents are preserved, and ask the CEO to avoid any further direct discussion with Mr Rashid about his exit.

Kind regards,
Sarah Whitfield
Partner
